system.design:
<!-- Demo is made up: it exists so the youi docs, tests and the hub have a system to show. Token values live in tokens/demo; this is the narrative. -->

# Design System: Demo

## Overview

Demo is a quiet, neutral interface with one hue to spend. The ground is white in light mode and near-black in dark mode, cards sit on it with a hairline border and one soft shadow, and text is set in Geist. Indigo is the accent, and it is spent only on action: the main button of a view, focus rings and links. Red is kept for danger and nothing else.

**Key Characteristics:**
- One accent, spent on action. A view has at most one filled button.
- Hairlines before shadows: borders separate, a single soft shadow lifts a card.
- 8px corners on controls, 12px on cards.
- Light and dark are equal schemes; every colour role has a value in each.

## Colors

- **Background** (background): the page behind every view.
- **Foreground** (foreground): body text and icons.
- **Muted** (muted): secondary text, placeholders and meta lines. It passes 4.5:1 on background and card.
- **Card** (card): containers that sit on the background.
- **Line** (line): hairline borders and dividers.
- **Accent** (accent, an alias of brand): the main action of a view, focus rings and links. **On accent** (on-accent) is the text on it.
- **Danger** (danger) and **Danger soft** (danger-soft): destructive actions and errors, as text on a soft wash.

## Typography

- **Label** (13px, 500): buttons, field labels and card titles.
- **Body** (14px, 400, 1.5 line height): running text and field values.

## Components

- **Button**: default for the main action, outline for secondary actions, ghost for toolbars, danger for a confirmed destructive act, link for navigation.
- **Input**: a single-line field with a label beside it. An invalid value turns the border to danger and says what is wrong in text.
- **Card**: one subject per card. Cards are never nested.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do give each view one main action.
- Do pair every field with a label.
- Don't hard-code a colour; use a token utility.
- Don't use danger for anything that is not destructive.

Background: the page behind every view.

Card: containers that sit on the background.
Danger: destructive actions and errors.

Foreground: body text and icons.
Line: hairline borders and dividers.
Muted: secondary text, placeholders and meta lines.
On accent: text and icons on an accent fill.
Out: every transition that settles.
Ring: every focused control, drawn outside it. Never removed.
Sans: every word in the interface.
Control: colour changes on hover and press.
Base: content that enters or leaves.
Fast: hover and press feedback.
Gentle: sheets and cards, with a soft overshoot.

Control: buttons and fields.
Card: the one soft lift a card may take.

contract.name: Button
contract.summary: Every action a person can take. Filled accent for the main action of a view; outline and ghost for the rest; danger only for a destructive act.

variant.description: default = the main action of a view (at most one); outline = secondary actions and row tools; ghost = toolbars and low-emphasis actions; danger = a confirmed destructive act; link = navigation styled as text.

size.description: 36px tall by default, 32px for sm; icon is a 36px square.

className.description: Extra classes, merged last with cn(); use token utilities only.

notes: size="icon" has no visible text: give it aria-label.
Focus is a 2px accent ring at a 2px offset; never remove it.
Disabled drops to 50% opacity and ignores pointer events.

do: Give each view one default (filled) Button for its main action.
Use variant="outline" for secondary actions and row tools.
Name the action with a verb: Save, Invite, Delete project.
dont: Don't render a raw <button> with hand-written classes.
Don't use danger for anything that is not destructive.

contract.name: Card
contract.summary: A container for one subject: card fill, hairline border, 12px corners and one soft shadow. Never nested.

className.description: Extra classes, merged last with cn(); use token utilities only.

notes: CardTitle renders an h2; keep the page's heading order.

do: Put one subject in a card: a project, an invoice, a person.
dont: Don't give a card a second shadow or a coloured border.

contract.name: Input
contract.summary: A single-line field: background fill, hairline border, 8px corners, 36px tall. invalid turns the border to danger.

invalid.description: Marks the value as wrong: sets aria-invalid and a danger border. Say what is wrong in text next to the field.

placeholder.description: An example value, never the label.

className.description: Extra classes, merged last with cn(); use token utilities only.

notes: Show errors in text next to the field, never with a red border alone.

do: Use a placeholder for an example value, and a label for the name.
dont: Don't signal an error with the border alone.

rules.title: No raw colours
rules.statement: Colour comes from tokens. Never write a hex, rgb() or hsl() literal in a component, class name, inline style or stylesheet; only the token source may define colour values.
rules.rationale: Every colour role has one light and one dark value. A literal colour cannot follow the scheme or a token change, and it hides from every audit.
rules.agent: Never hard-code a colour: use token utilities (bg-card, text-muted, border-line) or var(--demo-color-*), and look up the role with system_get_tokens.

rules.title: Render the design-system component, not a lookalike
rules.statement: A component named like a design-system element (Button, Input, Card) must resolve to the owned implementation in the components directory. A second implementation with the same name splits the system in two.
rules.rationale: Two Buttons drift apart: a fix to one never reaches the other, and the usage map cannot tell a reader which Button a screen shows.
rules.agent: Import components only from the owned components directory; never define or import another Button, Input or Card.

bad: import { Button } from "./legacy/button"; // a second Button implementation

rules.title: Use the owned controls, not native elements
rules.statement: Outside the components directory, render Button and Input instead of styling <button> and <input> by hand.
rules.rationale: Hand-styled controls skip the system's focus ring, disabled state and scheme, and they are invisible to the usage map.
rules.agent: Use <Button> and <Input> from the components directory; never style a native <button> or <input> yourself.

rules.title: One main action per view
rules.statement: A view shows at most one default (filled) Button, for the action most people came to take. Everything else is outline, ghost or link.
rules.rationale: The accent fill means "this is the next step". Two filled buttons make the person choose between equals, and neither reads as the next step.
rules.agent: Use the default (filled) Button variant for at most one action per view; make the others outline or ghost.

rules.title: Props use the contract's values
rules.statement: A literal value for an enumerated prop must be one of the values in the component's contract.
rules.rationale: class-variance-authority silently renders nothing for an unknown variant, so a typo or a value from another system ships as an unstyled control.
rules.agent: Call system_get_component before using a component's props; use only the listed values.

rules.title: Use token utilities, not arbitrary values
rules.statement: When a token exists for a value, use its utility instead of a Tailwind arbitrary value: rounded-card, not rounded-[12px]; shadow-card, not shadow-[var(--demo-shadow-card)].
rules.rationale: Arbitrary values copy a token's value at one moment. They do not change when the token does, and they make the usage map blind to which token a site meant.
rules.agent: Prefer token utilities (rounded-card, text-label, shadow-card) over [arbitrary] values; youiyoux check suggests the utility.
